block.d: Blocks incoming damage. Clears at the start of the owner's turn.

might.d: +1 Spell Power to attack weapons per stack. Resets after combat.

robust.d: +1 Spell Power to defense weapons per stack. Resets after combat.

poison.d: Takes damage equal to its Poison at the end of its turn, then loses 1 stack.

weaken.d: All Shield gained is halved. Loses 1 stack each turn.

broken.d: Takes 50% more damage from all sources. Loses 1 stack each turn.

curse.d: At the end of turn, if HP is at or below the Curse stacks, it dies instantly. Lasts the whole fight.

thorns.d: When an enemy attacks you, it takes this much damage. Clears at the start of your turn.

frustrated.d: Casting a word shorter than (stacks + 1) letters deals 1 damage to yourself. Loses 1 stack each turn.

layers.d: Every hit deals only 1 damage and peels off 1 layer. Once all layers are gone, hits deal full damage again. Poison ignores the layers.

field.d: Every hit deals only 1 damage and knocks out 1 cell. Poison ignores it.

block.name: Shield
block.text: Blocks incoming damage. Lost at the start of the owner's next turn.

might.name: Might
might.text: Each stack adds +1 Spell Power to attack words (for enemies: +1 damage per attack). Lasts this combat.

robust.name: Robust
robust.text: Each stack adds +1 Spell Power to shield words. Lasts this combat.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.text: When an enemy attacks you, it takes this much damage back. Clears at the start of your turn.

poison.name: Poison
poison.text: Deals damage at the end of its owner's turn equal to its stacks, then loses 1 stack. Example: 3 Poison deals 3, then 2, then 1.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.text: Halves all Shield the owner gains. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.

broken.name: Broken
broken.text: The owner takes 50% more damage from every source. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.

curse.name: Cursed
curse.text: Instant death: at the end of turn, if the owner's HP is at or below its Curse stacks, it dies. Curse never wears off during the fight.

frustrated.name: Frustrated
frustrated.text: Short words hurt: casting a word shorter than (stacks + 1) letters deals 1 damage to you. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.

slimy.name: Slimy tile
slimy.text: The tile is worth 0 Spell Power the first time you cast it. The slime washes off after that.

ptile.name: Poisoned tile
ptile.text: Casting it poisons you: +1 Poison, which deals damage equal to your Poison at the end of your turn, then loses 1 stack.

lock.name: Locked tile
lock.text: The tile is frozen in place: it can't be cast until the lock counts down to 0 (1 per turn).

condemn.name: Condemned tile
condemn.text: If it is still in your hand at the end of turn, it is banished for the rest of this combat.

ctile.name: Cursed tile
ctile.text: Casting it curses you: +1 Curse. If your HP is at or below your Curse at the end of a turn, you die instantly. Curse lasts the whole fight.

ftile.name: Frustrated tile
ftile.text: Casting it frustrates you: +1 Frustrated. While Frustrated, words shorter than (stacks + 1) letters deal 1 damage to you.

burn.name: Smoldering tile
burn.text: A tile on fire. If it is still in your hand at the end of your turn, you lose 1 HP. Casting it puts the fire out.

fortified.name: Fortified tile
fortified.text: A tile cast in iron. It is never discarded at the end of your turn (it stays in your hand) and enemies can't put debuffs on it.

crit.name: Critical
crit.text: Cast a word whose length exactly matches the weapon's sigil to trigger its bonus effect. [ ! ] tiles count as letters for this: with a 3-sigil weapon, SAW crits but SAW! does not, and HI! does.

energy.name: Energy
energy.text: You get 3 each turn. Every weapon costs Energy to cast. Cast any weapon as many times as you like while you have the Energy.

wild.name: Wildcard ?
wild.text: Turns into whatever letter makes a real word, so it helps you reach a word or a sigil length. It is worth 0 Spell Power and can never be upgraded.

bang.name: Exclamation !
bang.text: Must go at the end of a word, or after a single letter (U!, U!!!!). It can never be cast on its own. Each ! adds bonus Spell Power: +2, +4, +6, +10, +16… (consecutive ! stack).

comma.name: Comma ,
comma.text: Put it between two words to cast both in one action.

red.name: Red Paint
red.text: Casting it gives you +1 Might (+1 Spell Power on attack words for the rest of the fight).

blue.name: Blue Paint
blue.text: Casting it gives you +1 Robust (+1 Spell Power on shield words for the rest of the fight).

green.name: Green Paint
green.text: Draw 1 extra tile when the word is cast.

gold.name: Gold Paint
gold.text: +1 Gold each time the tile is played.

fragile.name: Fragile
fragile.text: This tile disappears for the rest of the combat after its first use (like Exhaust).
